items.q: In which phase of mitosis do the chromosomes line up at the centre of the cell?
items.qAf: In watter fase van mitose rangskik die chromosome by die middel van die sel?
items.explain: In metaphase the chromosomes line up along the equator (centre) of the cell.
items.explainAf: In metafase rangskik die chromosome langs die ewenaar (middel) van die sel.

items.q: In which phase do sister chromatids separate and move to opposite poles?
items.qAf: In watter fase skei suster-chromatiede en beweeg na teenoorgestelde pole?
items.explain: In anaphase the sister chromatids are pulled apart to opposite poles.
items.explainAf: In anafase word die suster-chromatiede uitmekaar getrek na teenoorgestelde pole.

items.q: The nuclear membrane breaks down and chromosomes condense. Which phase is this?
items.qAf: Die kernmembraan breek af en die chromosome kondenseer. Watter fase is dit?
items.explain: Prophase is when the nuclear membrane breaks down and the chromosomes become visible.
items.explainAf: Profase is wanneer die kernmembraan afbreek en die chromosome sigbaar word.

items.q: A human body cell has 46 chromosomes. How many chromosomes does each daughter cell have after mitosis?
items.qAf: ’n Menslike liggaamsel het 46 chromosome. Hoeveel chromosome het elke dogtersel na mitose?
items.explain: Mitosis produces two genetically identical diploid cells, so each has 46 chromosomes.
items.explainAf: Mitose lewer twee genetiese identiese diploïede selle, dus het elkeen 46 chromosome.

items.q: Human gametes have 23 chromosomes. Which process produces them?
items.qAf: Menslike gamete het 23 chromosome. Watter proses produseer hulle?
items.explain: Meiosis halves the chromosome number to produce gametes.
items.explainAf: Meiose halveer die chromosoomgetal om gamete te produseer.

items.q: Why must the daughter cells from mitosis be genetically identical?
items.qAf: Waarom moet die dogterselle uit mitose geneties identies wees?
options: To keep the chromosome number the same for growth and repair
To reduce the number of chromosomes
optionsAf: Om die chromosoomgetal dieselfde te hou vir groei en herstel
Om die getal chromosome te verminder
items.explain: Mitosis is used for growth and repair, so cells must carry the same genetic information.
items.explainAf: Mitose word vir groei en herstel gebruik, dus moet selle dieselfde genetiese inligting dra.

items.q: The phase of mitosis in which chromosomes line up on the equator of the cell.
items.qAf: Die fase van mitose waarin chromosome op die ewenaar van die sel in ’n ry staan.

items.q: The point where the two chromatids of a chromosome are joined.
items.qAf: Die punt waar die twee chromatiede van ’n chromosoom verbind is.

items.q: The division of the cytoplasm at the end of cell division.
items.qAf: Die deling van die sitoplasma aan die einde van seldeling.

items.q: A mass of cells formed by uncontrolled mitosis.
items.qAf: ’n Massa selle wat deur onbeheerde mitose gevorm word.

items.text: Before mitosis, during [[]], the DNA is copied. In [[]] the chromatids are pulled to opposite poles of the cell.
items.textAf: Voor mitose, tydens [[]], word die DNS gekopieer. In [[]] word die chromatiede na teenoorgestelde pole van die sel getrek.

items.q: Mitosis produces two daughter cells that are genetically identical to the parent cell.
items.qAf: Mitose lewer twee dogterselle wat geneties identies aan die moedersel is.
items.explain: True. Each daughter cell receives an exact copy of every chromosome.
items.explainAf: Waar. Elke dogtersel ontvang ’n presiese kopie van elke chromosoom.

items.q: In plant cells the cytoplasm divides by forming a furrow that pinches in.
items.qAf: In plantselle deel die sitoplasma deur ’n groef te vorm wat inknyp.
items.explain: False. Plant cells form a cell plate; animal cells form a cleavage furrow.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Plantselle vorm ’n selplaat; dierselle vorm ’n klowingsgroef.

items.q: Put the phases of mitosis in order.
items.qAf: Rangskik die fases van mitose in volgorde.

items.q: Give TWO reasons why mitosis is important in living organisms.
items.qAf: Gee TWEE redes waarom mitose belangrik is in lewende organismes.
points: Growth: it increases the number of cells.
Repair/replacement of damaged or worn-out cells / asexual reproduction.
pointsAf: Groei: dit vermeerder die aantal selle.
Herstel/vervanging van beskadigde of verslete selle / ongeslagtelike voortplanting.
